implementation: Rename prepares private candidate source snapshots and returns atomic edits only after actual reparsing and keyed binding preserve entity and resolution correspondence. Cancellation, resource stops and invalid candidates return no edits.

Original and candidate trees require owned CompletedParse values issued by successful ParseSession execution. Raw decoded trees cannot construct that native proof. Host writable snapshot grants are explicit and are not authenticated by wire decoding.

Exact mappings support unique adjacent segments independent of segmentation/order. Explicit candidate edits propagate across derived snapshots while all source bytes, URIs and revisions are checked, including unmapped tails. Ambiguous, transformed and source-encoding inversion is refused.

Typed native/CBOR request and reply boundaries preserve defined failures, reports and stops. NDF structural comparison now charges Work before enqueueing each child so Work exhaustion cannot expand a wide list's whole frontier first.

independent_review.scope: Eleven original native rename probe programs plus original and revised parser-proof source probes; the inherited value-comparator frontier was measured before/after and with a separate positive control, including final WASI. Execution manifests identify exact source, logs and linked binaries; original WIP source implementations were not all separately snapshotted.
independent_review.root_confirmation: Isolated frozen production tree passed native and WASI gates. A test-only explicit panic was subsequently replaced by direct construction after strict Clippy rejected it; that modified test is rerun on native/WASI and all quality gates are repeated.

integration: Only explicitly frozen rename/core/spec/review files and scoped evidence are included. Later Doc mixed, Doc labels and Grammar region priority work remain outside this tree.
log_normalization: Root logs use LF and a final newline. Original independent UTF-8 source/log bytes are preserved inside JSON strings with SHA-256.
unverified: T06, R006 and related contracts remain in progress; no task or acceptance group is completed. All 55 acceptance group statuses remain not-run.

This is native speculative rename plus portable values, not a completed process-provider execution envelope or host write authorization system. Parser/binding diagnostics remain caller-owned; the rename reply reports cumulative usage.
Full region/editor queries, LSP and browser adapters remain subsequent work. Raw wire data does not prove a foreign execution was authorized.

Doc mixed literal lowering, article labels and other pending domain operations are outside this checkpoint. Math/Circuit runtime, suite/apps, pure TEA UI, Playground, Pages and Doc document migration remain required.
One separately owned bootstrap performance baseline remains ignored; browser compilation and source delivery are not browser runtime tests or final acceptance.
